newsitem.title: USA: Homeland Bank holders approve Magna deal.
newsitem.headline: Homeland Bank holders approve Magna deal.

text.p: Magna Group Inc said Wednesday that shareholders of Homeland Bankshares Corp approved a proposed stock and cash merger with Magna.
The transaction, which received regulatory approval last month, is scheduled to close March 1, 1997.
Terms of the agreement call for Magna to issue 5,038,934 shares of Magna common stock and $91,966,970 in cash for the 5,703,378 shares of Homeland common stock.
Magna is a bank holding company with $5.46 billion in assets. It has 107 banking locations in Illinois and Missouri, a trust company, and a brokerage company.

Homeland Bankshares is a $1.2 billion holding company, operating 30 banking locations in Iowa. After completion of the Homeland acquisition, Magna will have more than 137 banking locations throughout Illinois, Iowa, and Missouri and will have total assets in excess of $6.6 billion.
